name: Mokshi Shah
tagline: Architecting deterministic AST parsers, metagenomic VAEs, and retrieval-augmented systems with human-centered principles.
status: Available for Summer 2026 SWE & AI/ML Research Internships
bio: I am a second-year B.Tech Computer Engineering student at VJTI Matunga (CGPA 8.94, SGPA 9.48) dedicated to bridging core computer science systems with modern machine learning. My engineering journey spans building custom recursive-descent AST compilers for code summarization (CodeSage), compressing 20k+ metagenomic sequences using Variational Autoencoders (eDNA Taxonomy), building full-stack platforms with Supabase & Groq (JobLink), and architecting real-time oceanographic RAG systems for Smart India Hackathon (FloatChat). Beyond engineering, I lead large-scale cultural operations as Department Head at Pratibimb VJTI, mentor students in Project X, and contribute actively to open source as a Hacktoberfest Supercontributor.
